name: Breakaway Supports
description: Generate one hollow support with dotted contacts under level faces.

faces.title: Faces to support
faces.description: Select one or more downward-facing horizontal faces. All selected faces must be at the same height.

on_part.title: Allow supports to start on the part
on_part.description: Allow the support to start on a level surface of the model. When off, it starts at the build plate.

spacing.title: Contact spacing (mm)
spacing.description: Distance between contact dots. Smaller values add more contacts and can support smaller faces, but may make removal harder.

diameter.title: Footprint margin (mm)
diameter.description: Total extra width added to the support footprint around the outer contact centers. Each side extends by half this value.

wall_thickness.title: Shell wall thickness (mm)
wall_thickness.description: Thickness of the hollow support’s side walls. The footprint must be wider than twice this value.

bridge_thickness.title: Minimum sacrificial top thickness (mm)
bridge_thickness.description: Thickness of the solid roof below the contact dots. For example, 1 mm gives five layers at a 0.2 mm layer height.

dot_diameter.title: Contact dot diameter (mm)
dot_diameter.description: Diameter of each small contact between support and part. Smaller dots may break away more easily but provide less support.

gap.title: Interface layer height (mm)
gap.description: Height of the contact dots between the support and the part. Set this to your slicer layer height; it is not an empty gap.

side_clearance.title: Side clearance (mm)
side_clearance.description: Approximate space around model walls when the support wraps around a part.
